notes:
June 10th 2026
Version 11.14+ (stable) / 12.15+(beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Added external sequencer (R)
* Added Chromatic (button) support for Treble side configuration (R)
* The "Drum Tx" on/off switch now matches the accordion correctly, and is now available for the Orchestra Bass and Orchestra Chord sections. (R)
* You can now rename your Organ presets directly in the editor. (R)
* A new "Effect Pot" screen lets you choose what the accordion's [EFFECT] knob controls while you play. (R)
* MIDI Volume, Panpot, Reverb and Chorus now show "Off" instead of "-1". (R)
* Plus various small UI fixes and clearer tooltips throughout the editors. (R)

* The Support Request window now lets you remove an incorrectly attached file before sending. (R,K)
* Enhanced the layout and functionality of the K-Editor. (beta) (K)
* Added external sequencer (R)
